# Quillbox pricing
### Simple plans for people who send newsletters

(Fictional product written for the grounding evaluation set. It does not exist.)

All plans include a 14-day free trial. No credit card is required to start.

## Starter
### $0 forever

For writers who are just getting started.

- Up to 500 subscribers
- 2,000 emails per month
- One sender address
- Quillbox branding in the email footer
- Help center access only

## Growth (most popular)
### $15 per month, or $144 per year

For independent writers with a growing list.

- Up to 5,000 subscribers
- Unlimited emails
- Custom domain and three sender addresses
- Paid subscriptions with a 5% platform fee
- Email support with replies within one business day

## Studio
### $59 per month, billed annually only

For small teams that publish together.

- Up to 25,000 subscribers
- Five team seats, with extra seats at $9 each per month
- Shared drafts and an approval step before sending
- Paid subscriptions with a 3% platform fee
- Priority support and a 99.5% delivery uptime target

## Questions

**What happens if I go over my subscriber limit?**
We will email you and you will have 30 days to upgrade or remove subscribers. We never delete your list.

**Can I cancel at any time?**
Yes. Monthly plans end at the close of the billing period. Annual plans can be refunded in full within the first 30 days.

**Can I export my subscribers?**
Yes, as a CSV file, on every plan including Starter.

**Do you charge payment processing fees?**
Card processing fees from our payment partner are separate from the platform fee and are passed through at cost.
